about.title: A southeast Johnson County district with several calendar layers
about.content: Blue Valley Schools is Kansas USD 229. The district serves portions of south Overland Park, Leawood and Olathe across 91 square miles. Its published profile lists 22 elementary schools, nine middle schools and five high schools, plus Blue Valley Academy, CAPS and Early Childhood services. The annual district PDF is the starting point for attendance dates, but school and program calendars remain necessary for activities, appointments and building events.

about.title: The first student date belongs to transition grades
about.content: Grades 6 and 9 attend a transition day one day before the EC–12 first day. Kindergarten orientation occurs on the EC–12 opening date rather than creating a separate districtwide kindergarten start. A single generic first-day label would therefore give families the wrong answer for at least one grade band.

about.title: Elementary collaboration days are not districtwide closures
about.content: Several Fridays are marked No School K–5 for teacher professional collaboration. Middle and high school students are not included in that label. Conference weeks introduce another boundary: the Thursday closure applies to EC–8 while grades 9–12 attend, and the following Friday is a no-school day for EC–12.

calendarNotes: Use the annual district PDF as the baseline school-year schedule and keep each printed grade boundary. When Blue Valley's current calendar page uses different attendance wording, show the current webpage wording and flag the difference from the PDF. Grades 6 and 9 attend Transition Day before the EC–12 opening. K–5 collaboration days do not close middle or high schools. During conference weeks, EC–8 students are out on the published Thursday while grades 9–12 attend, and all EC–12 students are out Friday. High-school finals use early release and building schedules. A downloaded ICS is a one-time copy and will not update automatically.

planningTips.title: Planning with the Blue Valley calendar
content: Match the first day to the student's grade. Grades 6 and 9 attend transition day; the EC–12 opening follows one day later.
Do not treat a K–5 professional-collaboration Friday as a districtwide closure. Middle and high school schedules continue unless another official notice says otherwise.
Read conference weeks as building appointment windows, not weeklong breaks. EC–8 students are out on the published Thursday, grades 9–12 attend, and all EC–12 students are out Friday.
Use the published early-release time for the student's level: high school, middle school and elementary schools dismiss at different times.
Check the live district or building calendar for athletics, performances, conference appointments and changes made after the annual PDF was issued.

districtFaqs.q: Do all Blue Valley students start school on the same day?
districtFaqs.a: No. Grades 6 and 9 attend transition day first. The next day is the published first day for EC–12 and includes kindergarten orientation.

districtFaqs.q: Are Blue Valley K–5 professional collaboration days no-school days for every grade?
districtFaqs.a: No. Those dates apply only to grades K–5. Middle and high school students are not included in the PDF's K–5 closure label.

districtFaqs.q: How do Blue Valley conference weeks affect student attendance?
districtFaqs.a: Buildings schedule conferences during the published week. On the named Thursday, EC–8 students do not attend while grades 9–12 do; the following Friday is no school for EC–12. Schools provide appointment times.

districtFaqs.q: What time does Blue Valley dismiss on an early-release day?
districtFaqs.a: The district publishes 10:30 a.m. for high schools, 10:50 a.m. for middle schools and 11:45 a.m. for elementary schools. Confirm program-specific transportation and schedules with the school.

districtFaqs.q: Does Blue Valley North use the same high-school block hours as the other high schools?
districtFaqs.a: Almost. On Tuesday and Thursday, Blue Valley North publishes an 8:30 a.m. start; the other four district high schools publish 8:35 a.m. All list a 2:45 p.m. dismissal.

districtFaqs.q: Are Blue Valley's 2027 graduation dates final?
districtFaqs.a: No. Blue Valley's 2026–27 calendar lists the graduation dates as tentative. Families should check with their high school for the confirmed ceremony date, time and location.

districtFaqs.q: Where should Blue Valley families find school-specific events?
districtFaqs.a: Use the child's building calendar for activities, athletics, performances and appointment details. The annual district PDF focuses on systemwide and grade-specific school-year dates.

districtFaqs.q: Does the Blue Valley ICS download update when the district calendar changes?
districtFaqs.a: No. It is a one-time import. Recheck the official district calendar and school messages for revisions, closures and building-specific events.

customSections.label: Which Blue Valley Calendar Should You Use?
customSections.content: Use the annual district PDF as the baseline source for first and last days, breaks and grade-specific no-school days. Use Blue Valley's current district or school calendar for activities, conference times, building events and changes made after the annual calendar was published.
